module.title: Appointments, Availability, Holds and Waitlists
module.business_purpose: The full booking (agenda) layer on top of the clinical appointment record. Models bookable resources (practitioners, rooms, equipment), schedule templates and rules that generate slots, availability exceptions, concurrency-safe slot holds (the distributed reservation lock for CU-10), confirmed bookings, reschedules, cancellations with policy-driven fees, waitlists and reminders. The canonical clinical appointment stays in module 08/18; this module owns the reservation lifecycle and anti-double-booking guarantees.
